note: What the agent must find for each provider and plan. C11 is worked out by the fit rules, never extracted. C12 is always unknown: the corpus has no price pages.

criteria.name: default duration
criteria.question: How long may one invocation run if you set nothing?

criteria.name: max duration
criteria.question: The longest one invocation may run when configured, generally available.

criteria.name: extended duration and conditions
criteria.question: Any longer limit that needs extra conditions (beta, special config, runtime versions).

criteria.name: CPU time
criteria.question: Limit on CPU time (not wall-clock time) per invocation.

criteria.name: max memory
criteria.question: Most memory one invocation can use.

criteria.name: request body
criteria.question: Largest request body one invocation accepts.

criteria.name: streamed response limit
criteria.question: Largest streamed response, or no enforced limit.

criteria.name: default concurrency
criteria.question: Concurrent executions without asking for more.

criteria.name: outbound calls
criteria.question: Limit on outbound calls (subrequests) per invocation.

criteria.name: plan dependency
criteria.question: Does the verdict change with the plan? Derived from the other cells.

criteria.name: price
criteria.question: Cost of the workload. Not in the corpus, so always unknown.
